entries.sought: Exact integer algorithms for the proleptic Gregorian calendar: a date to a day count, back, and the weekday

sources.title: chrono-Compatible Low-Level Date Algorithms (Howard Hinnant)
sources.said: days_from_civil: y -= m <= 2; era = (y >= 0 ? y : y-399) / 400; yoe = y - era*400; doy = (153*(m > 2 ? m-3 : m+9) + 2)/5 + d-1; doe = yoe*365 + yoe/4 - yoe/100 + doy; return era*146097 + doe - 719468. civil_from_days is its inverse; weekday_from_days counts from Thursday 1970-01-01.

sources.title: ECMA-262, Time Values and Time Range
sources.said: Time values count milliseconds from 1970-01-01 UTC on the proleptic Gregorian calendar, the calendar the tests read Date against.

entries.sought: How zic turns rules and zone lines into transitions, to compute them the same way
entries.value: outzone (rules taken in UT order, a wall-clock moment read with the save in effect; a line ends at its until read with the save then; the start type from the last rule before it or the first standard-time rule after) and writezone's optimize pass

sources.title: zic.c, tz release 2026e (the tz development repository IANA names at data.iana.org/time-zones/tz-link.html)
sources.said: outzone, lines 3415 to 3725: per zone line, save = 0; for each year, the untried rule with the earliest jtime = r_temp - (r_todisut ? 0 : stdoff) - (r_todisstd ? 0 : save); stop when ktime >= untiltime (until less stdoff and save by its kind); rules before starttime set startoff and the start abbreviation; at the end, starttime = until less save and stdoff. writezone, lines 2691 to 2732: a transition whose local time (at + previous type's offset) is not later than the previous transition's (at + the type before it) replaces it, or removes it when it returns to that type; a transition to the same offset, isdst and abbreviation is dropped.

sources.title: tz NEWS
sources.said: 2026b: zic versions 2023d through 2026a can mishandle a last transition to a new time type in slim output; use zic -b fat. 2026a: zic no longer generates a no-op transition when simultaneous Rule and Zone changes cancel each other out (Asia/Tbilisi, 1997-03-30).

entries.sought: A published method for sunrise and sunset by latitude, longitude and date, with its accuracy
entries.value: NOAA GML solar calculator: Meeus's equations; 0.833° below the horizon; accurate to within a minute between 72°N and 72°S, within ten minutes beyond

sources.title: NOAA GML, Solar Calculation Details
sources.said: The calculations are based on equations from Astronomical Algorithms, by Jean Meeus. The sunrise and sunset results are theoretically accurate to within a minute for locations between +/- 72° latitude, and within 10 minutes outside of those latitudes. For sunrise and sunset calculations, we assume 0.833° of atmospheric refraction. The calculator is no longer actively supported or maintained.

sources.title: NOAA GML solar calculator, main.js

entries.value: Canada 2026 (BC, Alberta, NWT, Manitoba), Morocco and Western Sahara 2026, Moldova since 2022, Baja California 1953 and 1961-1975, Iran 1979, Colombia 1992

sources.title: tz NEWS, releases 2025c to 2026e
sources.said: 2026e: Manitoba moves to permanent -05 (modelled from 2026-11-01 02:00). 2026d: the Northwest Territories stay on -06; Colombia's 1992-05-02 and Iran's 1979-05-26 spring forwards were at 00:00, not 24:00. 2026c: Alberta moved to permanent -06; Morocco moves to permanent +00 on 2026-09-20, also Western Sahara. 2026b: British Columbia moved to permanent -07 (modelled from 2026-11-01). 2026a: Moldova has used EU transition times since 2022. 2025c: Baja California agreed with California's DST rules in 1953 and in 1961 through 1975.

sources.title: splitmix.c (Sebastiano Vigna, 2015; prng.di.unimi.it/splitmix64.c redirects here)
sources.said: uint64_t z = (x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15); z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9; z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111eb; return z ^ (z >> 31); a fixed-increment version of Java 8's SplittableRandom, passing BigCrush.

entries.sought: What VED denotes beside VES, after Venezuela's 2021 redenomination
entries.value: VED/926 represents the redenominated bolívar (1,000,000 times the old VES); VES/928 stays the valid code for the same redenominated bolívar

sources.title: ISO 4217 Amendment Number 170 (1 October 2021)
sources.said: The Bolívar Soberano (VES) is redenominated by removing six zeros from the denominations. A new currency code VED/926 representing the new valuation (1,000,000 times old VES/928) is introduced on 1 October 2021 for any internal needs during the redenomination process, but is not replacing VES as the official currency code. The Central Bank of Venezuela will not adopt the new codes in the local system, VES/928 remains in use. The actual currency code VES/928 remains the valid code after 1 October 2021 to use in any future transactions to indicate the redenominated Bolívar Soberano.

sources.said: The Falkland Islands Pound (ISO4217 currency code FKP) has parity with Sterling. Banknotes and coins of both currencies are used interchangeably within the Falkland Islands.
